newsitem.title: INDIA: Renewed consumer demand lifts Indian sugar prices.
newsitem.headline: Renewed consumer demand lifts Indian sugar prices.

text.p: Indian sugar prices recovered on Monday from previous losses with renewed consumer buying lifting prices on low arrivals, dealers said.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by 10 rupees to 1,360/1,390 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved up by 15 rupees to 1,390/1,430 rupees. Sugar mill delivery rose by 5/10 rupees to 1,310/1,320 rupees.
"Offerings by millers and stockists remained at a low ebb as they were expecting a higher offtake ahead of festivals," one broker said.
